meta.name: parallel-debugging
meta.description: Debug complex issues using competing hypotheses with parallel investigation, evidence collection, and root cause arbitration. Use this skill when debugging bugs with multiple potential causes, performing root cause analysis, or organizing parallel investigation workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行验证多个假设,揪出复杂 bug 的根因
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对原因不明的复杂 bug,想用并行调查法快速定位根因
copy.tagline_en: Parallelize hypothesis testing to pinpoint root causes of complex bugs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're stuck on a tricky bug with multiple possible causes and want a systematic way to find the root cause

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按竞争假设法排查复杂 bug:先列出多个可能的失败原因,再收集证据并标注强度,最后仲裁出根因并验证修复。
howto.when: 当 bug 有多种可能原因、问题跨多个模块,或需进行根因分析/并行调查时,即可采用该技能。

say.text: 这个 bug 跨前端和后端,帮我按竞争假设方法排查根因。
say.note: 它会给证据分级并安排并行调查。

say.text: 我怀疑是缓存或竞态问题,用平行调查帮我裁定。
say.note: 它会仲裁假设并给出置信度结论。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will investigate complex bugs via competing-hypotheses approach: generate candidate failure causes, collect evidence with confidence levels, arbitrate root cause, and validate the fix.
howto.when_en: Use when a bug has multiple plausible causes, spans modules, or requires root-cause analysis and parallel investigation.

say_en.text: Use parallel-debugging for this payment timeout with several possible causes.
This bug spans modules; use competing-hypotheses root cause analysis.
say_en.note: It ranks evidence and runs parallel probes.

say_en.text: I suspect cache or race issue; arbitrate with parallel investigation.
say_en.note: It arbitrates and outputs a confidence level.
